criteria.criterion: A successful fetch advances the exact refs/remotes/origin/tickets ref by using +refs/heads/tickets:refs/remotes/origin/tickets
A failed or credentialless explicit-refspec fetch exits best-effort success, preserves the exact local tip, and emits an operator-readable warning
A table-driven shell integration proves compatible equal, behind, and strictly-ahead clones preserve or converge to the exact expected tip through the existing reconverge path
A compatible same-epoch divergent clone unions through the existing reconverge path and preserves both the local-only and remote-only event commits
A pre-epoch clone whose pre-fetch local tip is an ancestor of its readable prior remote tip adopts the pinned newly fetched epoch-bearing remote commit exactly
The reclaim adoption path never resolves the remote target a second time between validation and reset
Local-ahead and local-diverged pre-fetch states refuse reclaim adoption and preserve the exact local tip
A missing prior remote, a corrupt epoch record, or a mismatch other than pre-epoch-to-valid-epoch refuses reclaim adoption and preserves the exact local tip
Every refused adoption emits an operator-readable manual-intervention warning
Every convergence/adoption case leaves no merge or stash state
With REVIEWBOT_TICKETS_PAT unset, the generated entrypoint still invokes ensure/convergence against an existing clone outside the PAT block
A path-classifier test proves a change to infra/scripts/reviewbot-ensure-tickets.sh selects the review-bot deploy branch
An injected rebar store write failure after post_vote leaves the Gerrit vote recorded and returns normally through the existing best-effort artifact path
